family.description: Exploratory pilot of the matched-algorithm comparison of the lane route with AFF3CT [Cassagne2019] at the pin of c077a88b. The baseline arm is the gf2-coding LDPC batch decoder on the lane route with the AVX2 lane backend, under selectors that open the lane route to every wave size and edge count, a native build of the story's arms workspace; the candidate arm is AFF3CT's flooding f32 normalized min-sum decoder, the pinned external executable, one clone per pinned worker. Both are launched by the executable digests of dev/bench_results/ed3d490e/preparation/build-identity.json. The matched-algorithm settings both arms share are the parity-check matrix of the recorded AList (decoder.code.h_sha256), the recorded LLRs (decoder.input.llr_sha256), f32 precision, the flooding schedule, normalized min-sum at the declared factor, the iteration cap and syndrome stopping, with AFF3CT's syndrome check at depth one; P-19 compares each arm's reported settings with that declaration, and decoder.batching.batch_size is the per-frame decode both prepared quality records hold. The measured operation is the steady-state decode of 3be770d5: every worker is a thread pinned to one resolved CPU and owns one decoder built before timing, and a timed call makes every worker decode the cell's per-worker batch, workload.size.timed_batch, of the first recorded frames, including LLR conversion, the gf2 arm's lane transposition in and out, dispatch and extraction of the information-window decisions. Per code, the cells are a single-worker sustained-throughput cell, a single-frame latency cell and a twelve-physical-core throughput cell whose CPU identities the runner resolves at run time through host::resolve_core_arm. Every timed execution checks each worker's per-frame bit errors against the arm's prepared c077a88b quality record. The matched SIMD arms of AFF3CT are unavailable and carry no cell and no sample: flooding normalized min-sum INTER and normalized min-sum INTRA, for which the capability screen dev/bench_results/c077a88b/2026-09-08-c077a88b-preparation/capabilities-nr.json records 'the pinned build has no decoder for this combination', because the pinned factory guards flooding INTER behind __cpp_aligned_new, which that C++11 build lacks (dev/active/1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/c077a88b/findings.md). No nested pool is declared. The family declares the largest confirmatory cell count its first ledger attempt admits, as dev/bench_results/ed3d490e/aff3ct-matched/confirmatory-bound.json derives. This family publishes the matched comparison and selects nothing; the before-after families decide adoption on their own ledgers. This pilot observes the measurement resolution that the family's confirmation freezes; it decides nothing.

effect.rationale: A pilot observes the resolution that later fixes this family's margins.
effect.equivalence_rationale: A pilot decides nothing, so it declares no equivalence margin.
effect.material_gap_rationale: A confirmatory addendum fixes the material-gap threshold from this pilot's observed resolution.
